title_zh: 记录盆栽样本的叶片与茎变化

scenario.goal_zh: 核对样本身份与叶茎观察并约定按日期记录而不猜病因

context_zh: 园艺课程中，成年学员 Pia 与 Mateo 对课堂种植的一盆豆苗做观察记录。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: Is this specimen the bean plant from our first growing tray?

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: Yes, the label is still on the pot. It began to shed leaves last week.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: The stem is still upright, but two of the lower leaves have fallen off.

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: Should I write that it has a disease?

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: We haven’t established that. Record what we can see and compare the dated photographs.

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: All right. I’ll note the two fallen leaves and today’s date, without naming a cause.
